best_match.fbbt_definition: Cell that is part of the stalk connecting adjacent egg chambers in a vitellarium. Each stalk is usually composed of 5-8 interdigitating stalk follicle cells.

justification: The authors annotated this type with FBbt:00004910 'stalk follicle cell', a current (non-obsolete) FBbt cell term; FBbt has no adult-specific variant of it. The authors' typing is taken at face value.
